deploybot: :warning: paused stage=canary step=prefetch error=\"cache-lease deadlock\" retries=5/5. snippet: 2025-04-01T11:22:11Z prefetchtask lease acquire shard=kv-09 owner=unknown; retry->deadlock.
devin: owner=unknown again. probably an orphaned lease row. options: pin to last-known-good image, manual KV compaction, or wait for lease timeout (~20m).
ryan: change window is 40m left. leadership prefers not to delay. recommend manual pin + smoke.
nina: agreed. I'll pin to sha:1a2b3c4d and request manual promote. steps: set canary image->sha:1a2b3c4d, run deploybot --manual-promote, trigger smoke/canary-smoke, monitor for 10m.
deploybot: acknowledged. manual promote queued target=canary image=sha:1a2b3c4d initiated_by=nina. smoke job auto-triggered.
sam: updating release notes: "Pinned canary to previous image due to cache-lease deadlock; infra follow-up planned."
devin: filed INF-2901 "lease-orphan compaction + deploybot guard" and assigned to eng-infra.
ryan: smoke passed. promote complete, canary healthy. preserving change window. postmortem owner=devin. closing thread.
